changes.comment: TranscriptEvent, LiveTranscriptEvent and the update stream part are now unions discriminated by kind, so narrowing on event.kind types event.payload as that kind's payload type, fields an agent adds read as unknown, TranscriptEventOf<K> names the events of some kinds, and TranscriptEventPayloads maps each kind to its payload type, so a third-party adapter can type a builder generic over the kind. SystemPayload declares the prompt snapshot fields, ToolCallPayload the ACP title, and requestUsage takes a request event. Code that builds an event from a kind typed TranscriptEventKind and a Record payload no longer compiles; build that kind's payload type instead, or TranscriptEventPayloads[K] in a builder generic over the kind. Runtime output is unchanged.
